Behind every successful research programme stands a project manager who provides direction, helps shape strategic decisions, and transforms complex collaborations into tangible results. As a Project Manager at UMCG Research BV, you play a key role in national and international research projects that contribute to the health of tomorrow. One day, you may be coordinating an international consortium preparing an ambitious grant application; the next, you may be structuring a large-scale research programme and ensuring that researchers can focus on what they do best: advancing science. You will work in an environment where innovation, multidisciplinary collaboration, and societal impact come together, and where your ability to connect people, provide strategic advice, and drive progress truly makes a difference. What will you do? As a Project Manager, you will take a leading role in shaping, structuring, and strategically steering complex research projects throughout various phases of the research lifecycle. You are simultaneously an advisor, organiser, facilitator, and connector. You will support researchers and consortia at a strategic level and actively contribute to decision-making processes within national and international collaborations. No two days are the same. You will work on multiple projects simultaneously, collaborating with researchers, funding bodies, internal support services, and national and international partners. Key activities - You collaborate with researchers in the design and strategic positioning of research projects. - You lead complex grant application and funding trajectories, helping to shape scientific choices, consortium strategies, and project positioning. - You organise and facilitate consortium meetings, brainstorming sessions, and workshops. - You oversee research projects by monitoring progress, quality, risks, and budgets to ensure successful project delivery. - You operate within a complex stakeholder environment and connect diverse interests to achieve shared decisions and outcomes. - You coordinate contract negotiations and ensure agreements align with strategic project objectives. - You monitor project progress and ensure reports are delivered on time, meet high-quality standards, and are strategically well-founded. - You act as a trusted sparring partner, contributing to process improvement and strengthening collaboration structures. - You contribute to knowledge sharing and the professionalisation of the research project management field. A typical day You kick off the day by meeting with a researcher preparing a European grant proposal. Afterwards, you update a project plan, explore creative methodologies and perspectives to bring people together, and consider how complex ideas can be translated into concrete actions. Later in the day, you facilitate a consortium meeting where researchers, clinicians, and support professionals jointly determine the next steps of their project. You coordinate follow-up actions with international project partners, respond to questions, identify risks, and ensure projects continue to move forward. At the end of the day, you can look back on a day in which you have helped dozens of people work together to make impactful research possible. You navigate complex research and funding environments with confidence and are comfortable providing direction when needed. You enjoy connecting people and creating structure while maintaining the flexibility that research projects often require. You take ownership of strategic decisions and know how to engage and influence others. You are curious, quick to understand organisational dynamics and collaborative structures, and comfortable interacting with a wide variety of professionals. You take initiative, ask critical questions, and ensure agreements are translated into tangible results. About The Role We're looking for a Partnerships Manager to build Xolo's partner channel from a set of promising one-offs into a real, predictable source of growth. Our customers (freelancers, business owners and solopreneurs) across Europe, already live inside communities, newsletters, tool ecosystems and creator audiences that we don't own. Your job is to turn those places into a channel: co-marketing with companies serving the same audience, an affiliate programme that actually converts, and influencer partnerships that hold up commercially rather than just looking good. ✍️As a Partnership Manager at Xolo, you will: Build and own Xolo's partnership strategy, deciding which partner types are worth our time and which aren't Identify, research and shortlist partner targets across co-marketing, affiliates and influencers in our priority markets Run outreach end-to-end, from first contact through negotiation to a signed agreement Nurture partner relationships after launch so they keep producing, rather than going quiet after the first campaign Design and run the affiliate programme, including commission structure, tracking, payouts and partner enablement materials Plan and ship co-marketing activities together with our Growth and Product teams Own the operational backbone of the channel — contracts, CRM hygiene, tracking links, attribution and performance reporting against signups, revenue and CAC Cut, renegotiate or double down on partnerships based on what the numbers actually say Bring partner and audience feedback back to Growth and Product so we improve the offering itself 🧩 What makes you a great fit? At least 2-4 years of experience in partnerships, partner marketing, affiliate management, business development or influencer marketing, ideally in a SaaS or a fintech setting A track record you can point to: partnerships you personally sourced, closed and grew, with numbers attached Comfort owning a commercial number. You've been measured on revenue or CAC, not just on activities shipped Strong written outreach skills in English and the persistence to work a target list without being pushed Hands-on comfort with the mechanics: affiliate platforms, tracking links, UTMs, attribution, CRM and basic performance analysis A self-starter's temperament — this channel doesn't exist in its mature form yet, and you'll be the one building it Bonus: Spanish or Italian, experience with creator/influencer deals, or familiarity with the freelancer and business owner ecosystem 💭 Why work at Xolo? A team of Mavericks: We aspire to challenge the norm by encouraging bold thinking and embracing the unconventional. As a member of our team, you'll have the freedom to take risks, explore new ideas, and challenge the status quo We run like Clockwork: While we champion innovation, we also believe in operational excellence. Our processes are designed to be smart, efficient, and finely tuned Our Big-hearted nature: You'll work alongside mission-driven individuals who not only bring brilliance to the table but also lead with empathy. We believe that great work is built on strong relationships, and we're always ready to help, listen, and grow together 🚀About Xolo: At Xolo, we believe solopreneurs deserve better. We've spent the last decade simplifying entrepreneurship - removing bureaucracy, automating admin, and enabling thousands of people across the globe to build and run their businesses on their own terms. Our pioneering products are designed for freelancers, consultants, and microentrepreneurs who want to focus on their craft - not the paperwork. With more than 100 team members globally, we're building the best possible version of solopreneurship. 📝Xolo interview process: Our interview process is designed to ensure a great fit for both you and the company. It typically includes a screening call, an interview with the hiring manager, a practical task, and a final stage where you'll meet the stakeholders. If this sounds like your kind of role, please submit your resume and application details in English.
